method: Unmodified original PC functions, synthetic graph/save buffers and a real NuSpecial animation-object callback path. Code hooks observe callback arguments only; no callback or engine function is replaced.
limits: Saved-state tests use at most the 512 nodes representable by each 16-word bit plane; larger counts are not treated as safe native input.
Physical fixtures exercise NuSpecial with one static scene instance and animation control; other gizmo types, skinned-instance visibility and renderer/collision refresh remain outside this suite.
Native loader name rebinding is invoked only on empty/previously bound synthetic lists; shipped text loading and editor Collapse flattening remain open.
